Market today: Tech/chip names are mixed. Positive sentiment for Nvidia and Meta (new CEO) contrasts with upcoming Micron earnings.

Your holdings: SOXL (-36.23%) and SPAL (-35.27%) are flagged "SELL" and show significant losses. Their listed stops are above current prices, needing immediate review to prevent further margin-amplified drawdowns.

Watch: Micron's earnings report for impact on MUU. Monitor the broader chip sector for follow-through from Nvidia's positive news.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on leveraged losers while watching for catalysts in your winning tech positions.
plays: Re-evaluate SOXL's stop loss. At -36.23% and "SELL" status, its current stop at 200 (above current price 143.32) isn't protecting against further downside.
Re-evaluate SPAL's stop loss. At -35.27% and "SELL" status, its current stop at 21.38 (above current price 16.28) isn't protecting against further downside.
Consider adding to METU (+41.88%) on the positive Meta news, reinforcing a winning position.
